clue.text: Chap's show of amusement is a grave offence

parts.note: a chap is a man, here with the possessive S
laughter is the outward show of being amused

explanation.surface: A man's laughing fit is treated as a serious crime.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in Chap's is ignored, so MAN'S simply gives MANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Unlawful killing without malice is a serious crime in law, so it is a grave offence.

clue.text: Quiet semi designed for people with children

parts.note: mum means silent, quiet

indicators.note: designed suggests something fashioned anew, so the letters of semi are rearranged

explanation.surface: A peaceful semi-detached house built for families.
explanation.definitionFit: Mothers are people who have children.

clue.text: Exposed senior churchman flipped around end of week

indicators.note: the flipped churchman goes around the end of week

indicators.note: end of picks the last letter of week

explanation.surface: A senior cleric was exposed as having flipped at the end of the week.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flipped' turns DEAN into NAED, which goes around K.
explanation.definitionFit: Naked means bare, uncovered, exposed.

clue.text: Bewildered at clues, so struggle in vain

indicators.note: bewildered means confused, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Puzzled by the clues, a solver labours fruitlessly.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition reads as a verb, but it names the hopeless struggle itself.
explanation.definitionFit: An undertaking with no chance of success is a futile fight, a struggle in vain.

clue.text: Small fighting force's upper-class clown

parts.note: U denotes upper-class usage

explanation.surface: A small army squad's posh joker.
explanation.definitionFit: A military unit is a small group of soldiers.

parts.note: to hit is to strike
a toff is a well-to-do man

clue.text: Duck down behind this for cover

definitions.text: Duck down behind this for cover

parts.words: Duck down behind this for cover
parts.note: the duck's down fills a quilt named after it, which is a cover for a bed

explanation.definitionFit: This sea duck gives its soft down to the quilts used as bed covers.

clue.text: Old and terribly reliant Asian, perhaps

indicators.note: terribly means badly, so reliant is scrambled

explanation.surface: An old person who is very dependent, possibly from Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned term for someone from the East, with perhaps marking an example.

clue.text: Confined writer on setting up of study

parts.note: a pen is a writing instrument

indicators.note: in a down light, setting up means the study word reads upwards

parts.note: a den is a study

explanation.surface: A writer kept indoors to set up a study.
explanation.definitionFit: Penned means shut in, as animals are in an enclosure.

clue.text: Cobbled together dress given to model

parts.note: a model of car is a make

explanation.surface: A dress hastily put together is handed to a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: The dress is named after the model in the clue, but MAKE comes first in the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something improvised from whatever is to hand has been cobbled together.

clue.text: Lament golf in dreadful environment

the dreadful word forms the surroundings, so it wraps around the golf letter

parts.note: dreadful means dire
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: A funeral song is a mournful lament for the dead.

clue.text: 'Inculpate' is found in certain dictionaries

clue.text: Way to encourage a swimmer

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
to urge on is to encourage

explanation.surface: A tip on how to cheer on someone doing lengths of the pool.
explanation.walkthrough: The swimmer is a fish, not a person in a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A large fish prized for caviar is one example of a swimmer.

clue.text: Slump disheartened, facing heavy defeat, but shoot

parts.note: a rout is a crushing defeat

explanation.surface: A slump and a thrashing, yet still the team shoots for goal.
explanation.definitionFit: A new shoot on a plant is a sprout.

clue.text: Issues rental agreements after vacating residence

indicators.note: after places the rental agreements following the other piece
a vacated residence is emptied of its contents, leaving its outer letters

parts.note: leases are rental contracts

explanation.surface: Tenancy paperwork is issued after a flat is vacated.

clue.text: Pretended to have had an impact

definitions.meaning: an ... manner is a pretended, put-on one
to have influenced something is to have had an effect on it

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a feigned manner, and the past tense of to influence.

clue.text: Listen, this happens in autumn with leader being axed

parts.note: in autumn, the leaves drop from the trees

explanation.walkthrough: The autumn phrase is leaves drop; 'with leader being axed' cuts its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To listen secretly to others' conversation is to overhear on purpose.

clue.text: Hold one's position — or pose drunkenly

clue.text: Sack — anticipating popular news item

parts.note: getting the bullet is being sacked
in means popular, fashionable

explanation.surface: A dismissal ahead of a popular news report.

clue.text: Essentials for graduates thus employed

indicators.note: employed means taken in, so the graduates hold the thus word

parts.note: BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates
sic is Latin for thus

explanation.surface: Fundamentals needed for graduates to get jobs this way.
explanation.definitionFit: The basics are the fundamental essentials of something.

clue.text: Slim pickings ultimately on the African grasslands, say

say signals that the grasslands word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: the veld or veldt is the open grassland of southern Africa

explanation.surface: Thin pickings for grazers on the African plains.
explanation.walkthrough: The VELDT is the open grassland of southern Africa; said aloud it rhymes with felt, spelt VELTE here.
explanation.definitionFit: Slender and elegant, a slim figure is a svelte one.

clue.text: Hair of cat under storm centre?

clue.text: Do nothing, say, about a gun unloaded

parts.note: to state is to say

explanation.definitionFit: To stagnate is to remain inactive and fail to develop.

clue.text: Back in New Jersey, an assassin

parts.note: an is an article like a, giving A

clue.text: Note revolutionary chasing unknown soul

Che Guevara, the Argentine-born revolutionary

clue.text: Some local vets produce young

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

clue.text: Britain raised charge for grouse

clue.text: Conservative list showing no criminal offences

explanation.surface: A Tory list of candidates with no criminal records.
explanation.definitionFit: A record free of convictions is described as clean.

clue.text: Argue about crossing river with sick fighter

parts.note: sick means ill

explanation.definitionFit: An irregular soldier in a small independent band is a fighter.
